title: Neon Plasma Tree Lamp
description: A glowing plasma globe lamp with a black base sits centrally, its transparent sphere filled with branching, colorful tendrils in pink, blue, green and yellow resembling a stylized tree or neural network with leaves and flowers. The lamp is surrounded by a swirling cosmic background of dark blue, green and purple with floating botanical elements.
prompt: A surreal glowing plasma globe lamp with a black base and clear sphere, inside which colorful branching structures in pink, blue, green and yellow form a stylized tree with leaves and flowers. The lamp emits bright light against a swirling cosmic background of dark blue, green and purple hues with floating botanical elements and vines, vibrant ethereal atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
